title: 2017 Bowman Chrome Jacob Gonzalez 1ST Bowman Refractor San Francisco SF Giants
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2017 Bowman Chrome trading card features Jacob Gonzalez of the San Francisco Giants. The card is made of 20-point card stock and is an original licensed print. It is a part of the base set and is a rookie card for Gonzalez. The card also features a chrome parallel and refractor design. 

The card is in standard size and is perfect for any Major League Baseball fan. It is not autographed and has an unknown print run. The card is manufactured by Bowman in the United States and is a great addition to any sports trading card collection.
